title: Artispreneur Music Contract Record
description: Strict, harness-agnostic schema for one entry in the Music Contract Agent library. Every file in references/contracts/*.yaml MUST validate against this schema. Any agent runtime (Claude, OpenCode, a custom LangChain/LlamaIndex agent, a plain script) can parse these records without understanding prose — this is the machine-readable source of truth. references/00-contract-library-index.md is a generated human-readable view of the same data; regenerate it from the YAML rather than hand-editing it out of sync.

id.description: Stable slug, kebab-case, matches the template/questionnaire filename stem exactly.

status.description: 'sourced' = extracted from an uploaded third-party template; 'original' = drafted by this skill from the artist-protective framework; 'adapted' = built from a nearby sourced/original template to cover a gap. Only 'sourced' entries may claim to come from the Artispreneur Contracts Library verbatim.

parties.description: Exactly two named roles, e.g. ['Artist', 'Producer']. For multi-party types (e.g. LLC operating agreement) use the two most common roles and note others in rights_grant_notes.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes for the drafting agent.
